questions.question: What should you do if you receive a spam email?

options.A: Click on all the links to see what they are
options.B: Reply and ask them to stop sending emails
options.C: Delete it and tell an adult
options.D: Forward it to all your friends

questions.question: It is safe to open attachments from unknown senders.
Why is it important to cite websites you use for research?

options.A: To make your work look longer
options.B: To give credit to the original author
options.D: To fill up the bibliography page

questions.question: Write a proper citation for a website. Include the author name, website title, URL, and date accessed.
questions.correctAnswer: Example: Smith, John. 'Online Safety for Kids.' SafeKids.com. https://www.safekids.com/online-safety. Accessed: 5 Feb 2026.

options.C: A mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers and symbols
options.D: Simple words that are easy to remember

How can photographs be altered online?

options.A: They cannot be changed once uploaded
options.B: Using photo editing software to change colours, remove objects, or add filters
options.C: Only professional photographers can edit photos
options.D: Photos online are always exactly as they were taken

questions.question: Why is it important to know that photos online might have been edited?
questions.correctAnswer: It's important because edited photos can create unrealistic expectations, spread false information, or make us believe something that isn't true. We should be critical thinkers and not believe everything we see online.

questions.question: If you see something online that makes you feel uncomfortable or worried, you should:

options.A: Keep it to yourself and try to forget about it
options.B: Share it with all your friends

questions.question: Which of these is acceptable online behaviour?

options.A: Posting mean comments about other people
options.C: Being kind and respectful to others
options.D: Pretending to be someone you're not

questions.question: Describe a situation where someone might not follow online safety rules. What could be the consequences? What should they have done instead?
questions.correctAnswer: Example answer: Someone might click on a link in a spam email promising a free prize. The consequences could include: getting a computer virus, having personal information stolen, or being tricked into giving away money. Instead, they should have: deleted the spam email, not clicked any links, and told an adult about the suspicious email. They should remember that if something seems too good to be true online, it probably is.

questions.question: What does it mean to use technology 'respectfully'?

options.A: Using it whenever you want without asking
options.B: Treating others online the way you want to be treated

questions.question: List three ways you can report concerns about content you see online.
questions.correctAnswer: 1. Tell a parent, teacher, or trusted adult. 2. Use the 'report' or 'flag' button on the website or app. 3. Contact organizations like CEOP (Child Exploitation and Online Protection) or use helplines designed for young people.

questions.question: Before posting something online, you should always:

options.A: Make sure it gets lots of likes
options.B: Think about whether it could hurt someone's feelings
options.C: Post it as quickly as possible
options.D: Only worry about what your friends will think
